name: WORLD_LIGHT_V1
owner_decision: WORLD-INTERACTION-0 §10.2 and §11 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_WORLD_INTERACTION0_DOORS_LEVERS_FIELDS_AND_WORLD_CLOCK_DECISION_2026-10-01.md, owner answer 7a); number leased to LOOP-CLOCK-1 by the #1622 control plane
owner: current ChannelRuntime (the World clock read at the scope runtime's recorded time fact)
offer_gate: Offered by CLOCK-1 in every offered set (production, Item view and bundle World), requiring 6. With it selected, domain 18 is sent as a snapshot at admission, reconnect and channel transfer at the session's current revision and as a delta on a light change or a new Tibian hour, at most one per 10,000 ms (WORLDINT0-RL-18), read at the node's UTC time fact against the World clock epoch, which is the Unix epoch (a whole UTC hour) until a World ruleset carries world_clock_epoch_utc_ms; and the domain 1 type 2 player and creature entries carry the VIS-2 light (fields 11-12, at most 6 bytes, WORLDINT0-RL-20), changed on the wire at most once per 1,000 ms per entity. A player's light is its current LIGHT condition; equipped items and monster content carry no light source yet. Without it selected, domain 18 and fields 11-12 are never sent and the client renders a fixed day light.
